stories.title: Never Events: Eleven preventable safety incidents at Betsi Cadwaladr in a year, more than any health board in Wales
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board recorded the highest number of “never events” in Wales last year, according to its latest annual report. The health board logged 11 new never events during 2025/26 – an increase of six compared with the previous year. The report states the Welsh health board with the second-highest total recorded seven.

stories.title: New anonymous hotline set up to report cable theft on Welsh railways
stories.summary: Transport for Wales has launched an anonymous line for reporting cable and metal theft, the crime that stopped trains at Shotton in June last year. stories.title: Helen Walsh to discuss north Wales film On the Sea at Storyhouse next month
stories.summary: Helen Walsh, the writer and director of On the Sea, will appear at Storyhouse in Chester on Sunday 9 August for a screening followed by a question and answer session. She will be joined by Celyn Jones, one of the film’s cast. The Q&A will be hosted by Jordan King of the film magazine Empire.

stories.title: Artwork planned for Chester city centre to raise awareness of men’s mental health
stories.summary: Plans have been submitted for an artwork on the Forum wall in Exchange Square, next to Chester Market, aimed at getting men talking about mental health.
